title: Is 30% of TSMC's Advanced Chip Capacity in the U.S. Enough? Former Chairman Mark Liu Weighs In
author: Daniel Nenni
text:

In his first public appearance in Taiwan since retiring two years ago, former TSMC Chairman Mark Liu spoke candidly about some of the semiconductor industry's biggest questions:

● Why 30% of TSMC's advanced chip capacity in the U.S. may be enough—and what matters even more.
● The secret behind TSMC's victory over Intel.
● Why Taiwan's memory industry now faces “three butchers.”
● And a surprising revelation: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt is now manufacturing military drones in Taiwan.

From TSMC's silicon shield to the future of the global chip industry, Liu offered a rare insider's perspective.

Read the full analysis in the latest TechTaiwan newsletter.
